decisions.rationale: The median implementation correctly clamps to ordered inclusive bounds; the committed test passes and diff check is clean.
The candidate replaces case-insensitive sorting with case-sensitive sorting, directly violating the specification and failing the committed test.
Changing <= to < excludes values equal to the limit, contradicting the inclusive-boundary specification and failing its boundary test.
The candidate reverses the test expectation for a true readiness value; the committed suite fails, so the claim is false.

strategy_update: Prioritize direct agreement among specification, exact diff, and test results; use decisive verdicts when all public evidence aligns.
